title: REMEMBERING THROUGH TOUCH
short_description: A sacred journey back to yourself
description:
### AWAKEN YOUR HEALING HANDS

Discover the natural healing intelligence within your hands and learn to offer touch that is grounded, intuitive and deeply nourishing.
Through presence rather than technique, you will experience how conscious touch can become a powerful expression of care, connection and healing.

### RECONNECT THROUGH TOUCH

Step out of the thinking mind and into the wisdom of the body.
Through Healing Hands Touch, partner and group practices, meditation and immersive Sound Journeys, rediscover the transformative power of conscious touch and reconnect with yourself through presence, awareness and self-love.

### TRUST YOUR INTUITION

As the mind becomes quieter, your natural intuition begins to emerge.
Learn to listen beyond words, sense subtle energies and trust the inner guidance that has always been available to you.
Healing begins when we remember how to listen.

### EXPERIENCE TRUE CONNECTION

Discover what becomes possible when nothing needs to be fixed or achieved.
Through authentic presence and conscious touch, experience the beauty of giving and receiving, feeling truly seen, and connecting with yourself and others on a deeper, heart-centered level.

### WHAT YOU WILL EXPERIENCE

#### Connecting Touch

Experience the power of touch to create trust, presence and genuine human connection. Learn how conscious touch can open the heart, deepen relationships and remind us that we are not separate.

#### Supporting Touch

Discover how touch can become a silent language of care, safety and compassion. By offering and receiving supportive touch, the nervous system begins to soften, allowing the body to relax, restore and feel deeply held.

#### Grounding Touch

Reconnect with your body and the present moment through slow, intentional touch. Grounding touch helps you settle into yourself, regulate your nervous system and cultivate a deep sense of inner stability and peace.

#### Activating Touch

Explore the subtle language of energy, intuition and life force. Learn to trust your inner guidance and discover how touch can awaken vitality, openness and a deeper connection to yourself and others.

#### Healing Touch

Awaken the natural healing intelligence within your hands. Experience how conscious touch can become a powerful expression of care, connection and the body's innate capacity to heal.

***

For more information please contact: [ola@essencia.life](https://essencia.life/contact?topic=retreat#form)
